artifacts.notes: Immutable historical project input only. The sole editable inventory remains src/sources/papal-documents/bullarium-corrections-manifest.json; no separate papal-act body is created.

work.author: Triptych contributors
work.description: Project software that checks complete OCR/XML token identity and records physical source lines and explicit scan leaf identifiers. The method does not establish textual accuracy, reading order or authenticity.
work.title: Exact token and line-to-leaf mapping for historical papal sources
